rules.title: Interest on Security Deposits for RSO Units
rules.requirement: Landlords of rental units subject to the Rent Stabilization Ordinance with a certificate of occupancy first issued before October 1, 1978, must pay interest on all security deposits held for at least one year.

coverage.summary: Covers rental units subject to the Rent Stabilization Ordinance with a certificate of occupancy first issued before October 1, 1978, where the tenant occupies the unit for more than 30 consecutive days, excluding mobile home parks.
coverage.unresolvable: Excludes mobile home parks; requires tenancy of more than 30 consecutive days.

rules.exemptions: Mobile home parks are exempt from the interest payment requirement.
rules.quoted_span: Landlords of rental units subject to the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), which includes dwelling units, suites, condominiums, duplexes, guest rooms, and rooms in a hotel, motel, rooming house or boarding house occupied by the same tenant for more than 30 consecutive days in the City of Los Angeles with a certificate of occupancy first issued before October 1, 1978, must pay interest on all security deposits held for at least one (1) year for their tenants.
